decisions.reason: Neither semantic top-1 nor LLM choice provides an API for star information; both use GetBooksInfo which is unsuitable for star details.
LLM choice GetBooksInfo API is clearly more appropriate for searching books by genre and Lexile range than semantic top-1 City and State Search API.
Both semantic top-1 and LLM choice use GetBooksInfo API which only supports book info, not compiling documents or star info; no better alternative.
